mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% indicates aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicate a 'growth' regime where central banks delay tightening, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5% and GDP growth > 2.0% annually) signals overheating, triggering central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1250 thousand units (HOUST > 1250) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, supporting economic expansion and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1250.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.5%) signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS growth < -0.5% monthly) indicates weakening consumer demand, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS growth falls below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) indicate a tight labor market, triggering inflation concerns and central bank rate hikes that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.
